name: TASK-HEARTBEAT — alert when the laptop tasks stop running (hourly 11-18 IST weekdays)

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
return j.alert ? [{ json: j }] : [];

parameters.subject: =HEARTBEAT: the laptop tasks have not run for {{ $json.hours }} hours
parameters.message:
=The scheduled tasks on Aditya's laptop appear to have stopped.

Last run seen:   {{ $json.last_run_ist }}
That was:        {{ $json.hours }} hours ago
Its subject:     {{ $json.last_subject }}
Checked at:      {{ $json.checked_ist }}

Those tasks only run while Claude Code is open on the laptop. While they are
down, nothing books meetings, briefs founders, sends reminders or acts on
replies. The dashboard keeps updating from n8n, so it will look completely
normal and tell you nothing is wrong.

This happened before: the chain stopped at 21:48 on 1 Oct and nobody noticed
for 84 hours. A Spintly call was missed and an AI Signal Labs meeting reached
its start time with no invite.

To fix: open Claude Code on the laptop. The tasks sweep the gap themselves and
fire what they missed.

This alert repeats hourly, 09:00-22:00 IST, until a run is seen.
